nodes_update.note: Born London 1 Oct 1847; Theosophy 1889; India 1893; Central Hindu College Benares 1898; president of the Theosophical Society 1907-1933; guardian of Krishnamurti from 1910; Home Rule League 1916; Congress president Dec 1917; d. Adyar Sept 1933. Sidebar added 7 Nov 2026.

places.name: Central Hindu College, Benares
places.what: Founded July 1898; became a constituent college of Banaras Hindu University October 1917

glossary.term: Order of the Star in the East
glossary.def: Organisation created around Krishnamurti, under Besant, for those who expected a World Teacher; he dissolved it on 3 August 1929.

annie-besant: Birth, marriage 1867, separation 1873, Fabians 1885, matchgirls 1888, School Board, 1889 Secret Doctrine, 1893 India and Chicago, 1895 Gita, 1898 college, 1907 presidency, 1909 Leadbeater, Home Rule 1916, internment, Congress Dec 1917, death -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Annie_Besant
Esoteric Section, Bhagavan Das, Lucifer, Dharma Lodge 1904, Order of the Star in the East 1908, newspapers 1914, 1929 -> https://tforward.theosophy.wiki/besant-annie-wood-1847-1933
CHC July 1898 aims, Arundale 1908, Malaviya 1911, BHU Act 1915-16, college joined Oct 1917 -> https://theosophy.wiki/en/Central_Hindu_College
Gita 1895 co-translation, Girls' College 1904, Sanatana Dharma 1903, membership dated 1880 (conflicts with 1889) -> https://whowaswho-indology.info/?p=719
